# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 4 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 4
AnAO 4 (also written as AO4 or Administrative Officer Level 4) earns **$95,173–$104,304** gross — roughly $74,000–$80,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$107,000–$117,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 4 salary?
An Administrative AO 4 (also written as AO4 or Administrative Officer Level 4) earns $95,173 to $104,304 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
